name: Dana K.
quote: The supply pipe under our kitchen sink split just before midnight. The dispatcher talked me through closing the stop valve and the plumber was here in 40 minutes. He had to come back the next morning to refit the cabinet panel he'd taken off, and didn't charge for the second visit.

name: Marcus T.
quote: Our 9-year-old water heater was popping and the water smelled odd. They flushed the tank and replaced the anode rod instead of selling us a new unit. It took an hour longer than quoted because the drain valve was seized, but the price stayed the same.

name: Priya S.
quote: They found the slab leak with a thermal camera and cut out one 12-inch square of tile. The matching tile took a week to arrive, so the hole sat under a board for a while. The moisture report they left got our insurance claim approved first time.
